title: Statistical Power of Backtest Validation Pipelines: Planted-Signal Controls Against False Negatives — code, dated campaign outputs and paper (preprint, version 1.0)
description: Companion repository for the paper Statistical Power of Backtest Validation Pipelines: Planted-Signal Controls Against False Negatives (Hugo Marotin, preprint, November 2026, version 1.0). Folder paper1-backtest-power contains the evaluation pipeline under test (triple-barrier labels, fixed-cadence calendar, greedy scheduler, AIMD sizing, two-phase proprietary-trading-firm rules with ruin and censoring), the planted-signal positive-control module and its proof suites, the campaign drivers, every dated output file (meta.json, cellules.json, points.csv), the non-financial replication on 117,429 hotel bookings, the scripts that regenerate every table and figure, the pre-registered grids, and the LaTeX source and PDF of the paper. The NASDAQ data come from a proprietary feed and are not redistributed; the hotel dataset is public and fetched by script with SHA-256 verification.
